title: Define TUI state and render model
purpose: Define deterministic TUI state snapshots and render boundaries so the console can be tested without owning durable runtime state.
scope: Define TuiSnapshotV1 for dashboard, run detail, approvals, audit, recovery, ecosystem and support views.
Define cache invalidation and refresh semantics.
Define line-oriented deterministic renderer before richer terminal UI libraries.
acceptance_criteria: TUI snapshots are deterministic and serializable.
Raw secrets are redacted while secret handles remain explainable.
Render cache is never authoritative over RunStore or AuditJournal.
Golden text snapshots can validate key views.
failure_modes: TUI render output leaks raw secrets.
Render cache hides rollback-pending or degraded state.
